options.name: Wordmark
options.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create a new, refined, professionally art-directed visual identity for "VitalStep", a premium smart footwear and biometric technology brand.
Deliver exactly ONE final logo design, clean horizontal lockup, on a genuinely transparent RGBA background. All empty space must have alpha zero. No checkerboard pattern baked into the image, no colored rectangle.
One single flat ink color for EVERY visible part of the logo, including all lettering: exact cyan #20D8F8. No white, no second blue, no black, no gray, no color variation. No gradients, shadows, glow, lighting, texture, bevel, 3D, extrusions, noise or background.
Sophisticated modern identity design with the restraint and typographic precision of a high-end independent design studio. Crisp flat vector-like edges, balanced negative space, optical kerning. A considered, relatively light visual mass, not chunky or bubbly.
Composition: landscape 1536x1024, one horizontal logo centered, logo occupies about 70 percent of canvas width, generous clear transparent margins. Only render the logo and the exact brand name once. No slogan, annotations, swatches, captions, option numbers, grid, border, mockup or watermark.
Avoid generic healthcare or sports clipart: no ECG pulse, no heart, no circle enclosing a signal, no shoe, no footprint, no lightning, no mountain, no arrow, no generic standalone V icon. Entire artwork monochrome #20D8F8.
Direction 1: typography-led identity. Exact lettering: "VitalStep", with uppercase V and S, everything else lowercase.
Pure custom wordmark ONLY, no separate icon, no emblem. Use a beautifully drawn contemporary neo-grotesk, medium weight, compact but spacious enough to breathe, upright baseline, crisp open counters, controlled letter proportions. Give both t letters an identical subtle bespoke short crossbar detail and very restrained squared terminals to convey precision. V and S must feel custom and optically integrated. A simple memorable name expressed through excellent letter drawing and spacing, quietly confident, suitable for an established international technology company. Do not add decorative cuts to every letter. The name itself is the entire design.

options.refinementPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit, logo-brand.
Edit the attached VitalStep transparent logo. Change ONLY the abstract icon to the left of the wordmark. Preserve the wordmark exactly as it is, including its spelling "VitalStep", all typography, size, placement, and spacing. Preserve genuine background transparency.
Replace the two concentric quarter-circle arcs, which look like wireless signal, with two separate short elongated gently bowed diagonal strokes, one a little shorter and shifted up-right, with clean squared terminals. The strokes are almost straight, leaning up-right at around 45 degrees with a slight calm controlled curve. They must NOT share a circle center and must NOT form Wi-Fi arcs, radio waves, a chevron, arrows, wings or a sports swoosh. A quiet architectural geometric rhythm, compact and simple. Symbol same size and position as the old icon. Keep this a sober, crisp professional minimalist logo.
